name: Vraj Patel
intro: I build robots and electronics, from a gamepad-controlled quadcopter to guitar pedal PCBs.
about: I like figuring out how mechanical parts, electronics and code work together. Most of what I know has come from choosing a project and learning what it needs, whether that's soldering a board or programming a robot. In high school, I founded a robotics program and led 50+ members across two FTC teams.
